AISLE 2
THE LORE

He's been to space. He's run the city. He has never raised his price.

In 1985, Costco put a hot dog and a soda on the menu for $1.50. The Cold War ended. The internet happened. Three recessions, one pandemic and roughly thirty-eight trillion dollars of new federal debt later, it still costs $1.50. It is, by some distance, the most stable thing in America. $HOTDOG is the token for people who noticed.

Destination: the Moon.
Flag planted. Price unchanged.
Run responsibly.
Every proposal to raise it: cancelled.
Built different.
Brick by brick, to the blueprint.

ON THE RECORD

Forty-one years of Costco executives being asked the same question.

2009
“That I'm dead.”

Jim Sinegal, co-founder, asked what it would mean if the price ever went up

2018
“If you raise the effing hot dog, I will kill you. Figure it out.”

Jim Sinegal to CEO Craig Jelinek, as Jelinek tells it

2022
“Hold the price on the hot dog and the soda a little longer, forever.”

Richard Galanti, CFO, on an earnings call

2024
“The $1.50 hot dog price is safe.”

Gary Millerchip, CFO, on his first earnings call

2026
“The hot dog price will not change as long as I'm around.”

Ron Vachris, CEO

Activate your membership
1
Get a wallet that knows Robinhood Chain

Robinhood Wallet has it built in. MetaMask, Rabby and Trust Wallet work too: add the network in one click (chain ID 4663; gas is paid in ETH).

Add Robinhood Chain to your wallet →
2
Get ETH onto Robinhood Chain

In the Robinhood app, send ETH to your wallet and choose the Robinhood Chain network. Or bridge from Ethereum, Arbitrum or Base. Relay and Across take seconds; the canonical Arbitrum bridge takes about ten minutes. Keep a little ETH for gas.

Open the bridge →
3
Open Uniswap and paste the contract

$HOTDOG lives in a Uniswap v3 pool on Robinhood Chain. Paste the contract address as the token you're buying (never search by name) and check it matches this page character for character.

Trade $HOTDOG on Uniswap →
4
Swap into $HOTDOG

The pool is $HOTDOG / COST (yes, tokenized Costco stock) and Uniswap routes from ETH through COST for you. Set a sensible slippage, confirm in your wallet, and you're in. Then hold it like Costco holds the price.
